author: GameSpot
description:
Meet Loki Laufeyson, the God of Mischief and God of Lies! In this Character Guide, we cover his unpredictable toolkit so you can outsmart your rivals in every battle.

Learn about Loki’s illusion-based feints, counters, icy projectiles, magical attacks, and erratic movement. Dominate with his high-risk playstyle, which is built around confusing opponents and exploiting their bad habits to your advantage!

MARVEL Tōkon: Fighting Souls is coming to PS5 and PC on August 6th, 2026 PT!
